commands.name: cat file | claude -p "query"
commands.description: Process piped content

commands.name: claude
commands.description: Start interactive session

commands.name: claude -c
commands.description: Continue most recent conversation in current directory

commands.name: claude -c -p "query"
commands.description: Continue via SDK

commands.name: claude -p "query"
commands.description: Query via SDK, then exit

commands.name: claude -r "<session>" "query"
commands.description: Resume session by ID or name

commands.name: claude "query"
commands.description: Start interactive session with initial prompt

commands.name: claude agents
commands.description: List all configured [subagents](/en/sub-agents), grouped by source

commands.name: claude auth login
commands.description: Sign in to your Anthropic account. Use `--email` to pre-fill your email address, `--sso` to force SSO authentication, and `--console` to sign in with Anthropic Console for API usage billing instead of a Claude subscription

commands.name: claude auth logout
commands.description: Log out from your Anthropic account

commands.name: claude auth status
commands.description: Show authentication status as JSON. Use `--text` for human-readable output. Exits with code 0 if logged in, 1 if not

commands.name: claude auto-mode defaults
commands.description: Print the built-in [auto mode](/en/permission-modes#eliminate-prompts-with-auto-mode) classifier rules as JSON. Use `claude auto-mode config` to see your effective config with settings applied

commands.name: claude install [version]
commands.description: Install or reinstall the native binary. Accepts a version like `2.1.118`, or `stable` or `latest`. See [Install a specific version](/en/setup#install-a-specific-version)

commands.name: claude mcp
commands.description: Configure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers

commands.name: claude plugin
commands.description: Manage Claude Code [plugins](/en/plugins). Alias: `claude plugins`. See [plugin reference](/en/plugins-reference#cli-commands-reference) for subcommands

commands.name: claude project purge [path]
commands.description: Delete all local Claude Code state for a project: transcripts, task lists, debug logs, file-edit history, prompt history lines, and the project's entry in `~/.claude.json`. Omit `[path]` to pick from an interactive list. Flags: `--dry-run` to preview, `-y`/`--yes` to skip confirmation, `-i`/`--interactive` to confirm each item, `--all` for every project. See [Clear local data](/en/claude-directory#clear-local-data)

commands.name: claude remote-control
commands.description: Start a [Remote Control](/en/remote-control) server to control Claude Code from Claude.ai or the Claude app. Runs in server mode (no local interactive session). See [Server mode flags](/en/remote-control#start-a-remote-control-session)

commands.name: claude setup-token
commands.description: Generate a long-lived OAuth token for CI and scripts. Prints the token to the terminal without saving it. Requires a Claude subscription. See [Generate a long-lived token](/en/authentication#generate-a-long-lived-token)

commands.name: claude ultrareview [target]
commands.description: Run [ultrareview](/en/ultrareview#run-ultrareview-non-interactively) non-interactively. Prints findings to stdout and exits 0 on success or 1 on failure. Use `--json` for the raw payload and `--timeout <minutes>` to override the 30-minute default

commands.name: claude update
commands.description: Update to latest version

flags.name: --add-dir
flags.description: Add additional working directories for Claude to read and edit files. Grants file access; most `.claude/` configuration is [not discovered](/en/permissions#additional-directories-grant-file-access-not-configuration) from these directories. Validates each path exists as a directory. To persist these directories across sessions, set [`permissions.additionalDirectories`](/en/settings#permission-settings) in settings

flags.name: --agent
flags.description: Specify an agent for the current session (overrides the `agent` setting)

flags.name: --agents
flags.description: Define custom subagents dynamically via JSON. Uses the same field names as subagent [frontmatter](/en/sub-agents#supported-frontmatter-fields), plus a `prompt` field for the agent's instructions

flags.name: --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions
flags.description: Add `bypassPermissions` to the `Shift+Tab` mode cycle without starting in it. Lets you begin in a different mode like `plan` and switch to `bypassPermissions` later. See [permission modes](/en/permission-modes#skip-all-checks-with-bypasspermissions-mode)

flags.name: --allowedTools
flags.description: Tools that execute without prompting for permission. See [permission rule syntax](/en/settings#permission-rule-syntax) for pattern matching. To restrict which tools are available, use `--tools` instead

flags.name: --append-system-prompt
flags.description: Append custom text to the end of the default system prompt

flags.name: --append-system-prompt-file
flags.description: Load additional system prompt text from a file and append to the default prompt

flags.name: --bare
flags.description: Minimal mode: skip auto-discovery of hooks, skills, plugins, MCP servers, auto memory, and CLAUDE.md so scripted calls start faster. Claude has access to Bash, file read, and file edit tools. Sets [`CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE`](/en/env-vars). See [bare mode](/en/headless#start-faster-with-bare-mode)

flags.name: --betas
flags.description: Beta headers to include in API requests (API key users only)

flags.name: --channels
flags.description: (Research preview) MCP servers whose [channel](/en/channels) notifications Claude should listen for in this session. Space-separated list of `plugin:<name>@<marketplace>` entries. Requires Claude.ai authentication

flags.name: --chrome
flags.description: Enable [Chrome browser integration](/en/chrome) for web automation and testing

flags.name: --dangerously-load-development-channels
flags.description: Enable [channels](/en/channels-reference#test-during-the-research-preview) that are not on the approved allowlist, for local development. Accepts `plugin:<name>@<marketplace>` and `server:<name>` entries. Prompts for confirmation

flags.name: --dangerously-skip-permissions
flags.description: Skip permission prompts. Equivalent to `--permission-mode bypassPermissions`. See [permission modes](/en/permission-modes#skip-all-checks-with-bypasspermissions-mode) for what this does and does not skip

flags.name: --debug
flags.description: Enable debug mode with optional category filtering (for example, `"api,hooks"` or `"!statsig,!file"`)

flags.name: --debug-file <path>
flags.description: Write debug logs to a specific file path. Implicitly enables debug mode. Takes precedence over `CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOGS_DIR`

flags.name: --disable-slash-commands
flags.description: Disable all skills and commands for this session

flags.name: --disallowedTools
flags.description: Tools that are removed from the model's context and cannot be used

flags.name: --effort
flags.description: Set the [effort level](/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level) for the current session. Options: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`; available levels depend on the model. Overrides the [`effortLevel`](/en/settings#available-settings) setting for this session and does not persist

flags.name: --enable-auto-mode
flags.description: {/* max-version: 2.1.110 */}Removed in v2.1.111. Auto mode is now in the `Shift+Tab` cycle by default; use `--permission-mode auto` to start in it

flags.name: --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections
flags.description: Move per-machine sections from the system prompt (working directory, environment info, memory paths, git status) into the first user message. Improves prompt-cache reuse across different users and machines running the same task. Only applies with the default system prompt; ignored when `--system-prompt` or `--system-prompt-file` is set. Use with `-p` for scripted, multi-user workloads

flags.name: --fallback-model
flags.description: Enable automatic fallback to specified model when default model is overloaded (print mode only)

flags.name: --fork-session
flags.description: When resuming, create a new session ID instead of reusing the original (use with `--resume` or `--continue`)

flags.name: --from-pr
flags.description: Resume sessions linked to a specific pull request. Accepts a PR number, a GitHub or GitHub Enterprise PR URL, a GitLab merge request URL, or a Bitbucket pull request URL. Sessions are linked automatically when Claude creates the pull request

flags.name: --ide
flags.description: Automatically connect to IDE on startup if exactly one valid IDE is available

flags.name: --include-hook-events
flags.description: Include all hook lifecycle events in the output stream. Requires `--output-format stream-json`

flags.name: --include-partial-messages
flags.description: Include partial streaming events in output. Requires `--print` and `--output-format stream-json`

flags.name: --init
flags.description: Run [Setup hooks](/en/hooks#setup) with the `init` matcher before the session (print mode only)

flags.name: --init-only
flags.description: Run [Setup](/en/hooks#setup) and `SessionStart` hooks, then exit without starting a conversation

flags.name: --input-format
flags.description: Specify input format for print mode (options: `text`, `stream-json`)

flags.name: --json-schema
flags.description: Get validated JSON output matching a JSON Schema after agent completes its workflow (print mode only, see [structured outputs](/en/agent-sdk/structured-outputs))

flags.name: --maintenance
flags.description: Run [Setup hooks](/en/hooks#setup) with the `maintenance` matcher before the session (print mode only)

flags.name: --max-budget-usd
flags.description: Maximum dollar amount to spend on API calls before stopping (print mode only)

flags.name: --max-turns
flags.description: Limit the number of agentic turns (print mode only). Exits with an error when the limit is reached. No limit by default

flags.name: --mcp-config
flags.description: Load MCP servers from JSON files or strings (space-separated)

flags.name: --model
flags.description: Sets the model for the current session with an alias for the latest model (`sonnet` or `opus`) or a model's full name. Overrides the [`model`](/en/settings#available-settings) setting and [`ANTHROPIC_MODEL`](/en/model-config#environment-variables)

flags.name: --no-chrome
flags.description: Disable [Chrome browser integration](/en/chrome) for this session

flags.name: --no-session-persistence
flags.description: Disable session persistence so sessions are not saved to disk and cannot be resumed. Print mode only. The [`CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY`](/en/env-vars) environment variable does the same in any mode

flags.name: --output-format
flags.description: Specify output format for print mode (options: `text`, `json`, `stream-json`)

flags.name: --permission-mode
flags.description: Begin in a specified [permission mode](/en/permission-modes). Accepts `default`, `acceptEdits`, `plan`, `auto`, `dontAsk`, or `bypassPermissions`. Overrides `defaultMode` from settings files

flags.name: --permission-prompt-tool
flags.description: Specify an MCP tool to handle permission prompts in non-interactive mode

flags.name: --plugin-dir
flags.description: Load a plugin from a directory or `.zip` archive for this session only. Each flag takes one path. Repeat the flag for multiple plugins: `--plugin-dir A --plugin-dir B.zip`

flags.name: --plugin-url
flags.description: Fetch a plugin `.zip` archive from a URL for this session only. Repeat the flag for multiple plugins, or pass space-separated URLs in a single quoted value

flags.name: --remote
flags.description: Create a new [web session](/en/claude-code-on-the-web) on claude.ai with the provided task description

flags.name: --remote-control-session-name-prefix <prefix>
flags.description: Prefix for auto-generated [Remote Control](/en/remote-control) session names when no explicit name is set. Defaults to your machine's hostname, producing names like `myhost-graceful-unicorn`. Set `CLAUDE_REMOTE_CONTROL_SESSION_NAME_PREFIX` for the same effect

flags.name: --replay-user-messages
flags.description: Re-emit user messages from stdin back on stdout for acknowledgment. Requires `--input-format stream-json` and `--output-format stream-json`

flags.name: --session-id
flags.description: Use a specific session ID for the conversation (must be a valid UUID)

flags.name: --setting-sources
flags.description: Comma-separated list of setting sources to load (`user`, `project`, `local`)

flags.name: --settings
flags.description: Path to a settings JSON file or an inline JSON string. Values you set here override the same keys in your `settings.json` files for this session. Keys you omit keep their file-based values. See [settings precedence](/en/settings#settings-precedence)

flags.name: --strict-mcp-config
flags.description: Only use MCP servers from `--mcp-config`, ignoring all other MCP configurations

flags.name: --system-prompt
flags.description: Replace the entire system prompt with custom text

flags.name: --system-prompt-file
flags.description: Load system prompt from a file, replacing the default prompt

flags.name: --teammate-mode
flags.description: Set how [agent team](/en/agent-teams) teammates display: `auto` (default), `in-process`, or `tmux`. Overrides the [`teammateMode`](/en/settings#available-settings) setting for this session. See [Choose a display mode](/en/agent-teams#choose-a-display-mode)

flags.name: --teleport
flags.description: Resume a [web session](/en/claude-code-on-the-web) in your local terminal

flags.name: --tmux
flags.description: Create a tmux session for the worktree. Requires `--worktree`. Uses iTerm2 native panes when available; pass `--tmux=classic` for traditional tmux

flags.name: --tools
flags.description: Restrict which built-in tools Claude can use. Use `""` to disable all, `"default"` for all, or tool names like `"Bash,Edit,Read"`

flags.name: --verbose
flags.description: Enable verbose logging, shows full turn-by-turn output. Overrides the [`viewMode`](/en/settings#available-settings) setting for this session

flags.name: `--continue`, `-c`
flags.description: Load the most recent conversation in the current directory. Includes sessions that added this directory with `/add-dir`

flags.name: `--name`, `-n`
flags.description:
Set a display name for the session, shown in `/resume` and the terminal title. You can resume a named session with `claude --resume `.

[`/rename`](/en/commands) changes the name mid-session and also shows it on the prompt bar

flags.name: `--print`, `-p`
flags.description: Print response without interactive mode (see [Agent SDK documentation](/en/agent-sdk/overview) for programmatic usage details)

flags.name: `--remote-control`, `--rc`
flags.description: Start an interactive session with [Remote Control](/en/remote-control#start-a-remote-control-session) enabled so you can also control it from claude.ai or the Claude app. Optionally pass a name for the session

flags.name: `--resume`, `-r`
flags.description: Resume a specific session by ID or name, or show an interactive picker to choose a session. Includes sessions that added this directory with `/add-dir`

flags.name: `--version`, `-v`
flags.description: Output the version number

flags.name: `--worktree`, `-w`
flags.description: Start Claude in an isolated [git worktree](/en/worktrees) at `<repo>/.claude/worktrees/<name>`. If no name is given, one is auto-generated. Pass `#<number>` or a GitHub pull request URL to fetch that PR from `origin` and branch the worktree from it
